name: Lola la Trailera (La Corcholata) at Mercado Martínez de la Torre
description: Stall in the Guerrero neighbourhood market that many call home to the best cecina tacos in the city. The cecina and longaniza are the signature; the menu also has adobada, suadero and quesadillas de sesos, plus fresh aguas. Cecina and longaniza are sold by weight to take home.
special_quality: The cecina taco that Chilango and Time Out both single out as the market's must-eat.
address: Mercado Martínez de la Torre, Guerrero (Mon-Sun roughly 9am-6pm per Time Out; verify)

name: Barbacoa El Mejor at Mercado Martínez de la Torre
description: Oven-roasted mutton brought in daily from Milpa Alta, carved to order at the butcher block, reportedly by Ignacio Ramírez since 2000. Mexico News Daily names it the standout barbacoa in a market of roughly 600 stalls. Time Out also flags Barbacoa de Milpa Alta in the same market (costilla and lomo go early).
special_quality: Milpa Alta mutton carved to order in a working Guerrero market few visitors reach.
address: Mercado Martínez de la Torre, Guerrero

name: Comedor Los Güeros at Mercado Martínez de la Torre
description: Fonda recommended by market vendors themselves. It serves a traditional four-course comida corrida, and the broths are the highlight. Chilango includes it in its five essential stops.
special_quality: A vendor-endorsed four-course comida corrida inside a working market.
address: Mercado Martínez de la Torre, Guerrero

name: Mercado Martínez de la Torre
description: Guerrero market of around 600 stalls, overlooked by most non-locals, praised for meats, moles, barbacoa, seafood and tamales. Time Out rates it among the best markets to eat in and puts a meal around 80 pesos. Its Christmas romería is known for tortas de bacalao and romeritos.
special_quality: A genuine neighbourhood mercado where the food is cheap and tourists are scarce.
address: Mercado Martínez de la Torre, Guerrero

name: Taquería Cinco Hermanos at Mercado de la Merced
description: Family taquería in the Banquetón food zone on the market perimeter, near pasillo 9. CNN and Expansión both name it for tacos de suadero and tripa, calling them among the city's best. Sources date from 2018-2019, so verify it is still operating.
special_quality: Suadero and tripa in the Banquetón of the city's largest market.
address: Banquetón, Mercado de la Merced, Venustiano Carranza

name: El Pollo (quesadillas de huitlacoche) at Mercado de la Merced
description: Banquetón stall serving fried quesadillas stuffed with huitlacoche, featured in CNN's walk through La Merced. A good example of the market's cooked-to-order antojitos. Sources date from 2018-2019; confirm before going.

name: Tostadas Coyoacán at Mercado de Coyoacán
description: The best-known stand in the Coyoacán market and largely responsible for its tostada fame, with bright yellow photo menus and dozens of toppings. Seafood tostadas (pulpo, jaiba) draw praise. Listed at Ignacio Allende s/n, locales 169, 181, 182; sources say roughly 11am-6pm.
special_quality: The stall that made the market's tostada reputation.
address: Ignacio Allende s/n, locales 169, 181 y 182, Mercado de Coyoacán

name: La Chaparrita at Mercado de Coyoacán
description: Decades-old Coyoacán market stall (reports of 50-60+ years) known for tostadas de pata. Also serves about 15 guisados, with strong chicken tinga and black mole. Chilango features it among tostada options.
special_quality: Tostada de pata at one of the market's oldest stalls.

name: Mercado Portales
description: Benito Juárez neighbourhood market known for its food stalls rather than produce: pancita, pit barbacoa, tripa tacos, and weekend-only rabbit barbacoa. Time Out recommends the huarache with salsa verde and steak and Los Cochinitos' carnitas with habanero salsa. Crowded on weekends with an outdoor tianguis.

description: Seafood restaurant at the back of the San Pedro de los Pinos market (operating since 1957). Very broad menu: aguachiles, cocteles, ostiones, pulpo, camarones every way. Praised for chalupitas de ceviche; prices are accessible.
